options: She asked me where did the committee meet.
She asked me where the committee met.
She asked me where the committee did meet.
She asked me where met the committee.
answers: She asked me where the committee met.
questions.explanation: 间接问句要用陈述语序，主语在动词前，不用 did。
questions.evidence: The committee met on Tuesday evenings in a small room above the library.

options: He asked whether the farms would receive a fixed share.
He asked whether would the farms receive a fixed share.
He asked whether did the farms receive a fixed share.
He asked that whether the farms receive a fixed share.
answers: He asked whether the farms would receive a fixed share.
questions.explanation: whether 引导的间接问句同样用陈述语序，且不再加 that。
questions.evidence: He argued that farmers should receive a fixed share first

options: What worried the committee was how quickly the town could recover.
What worried the committee was how quickly could the town recover.
What worried the committee was how quickly the town could recover?
That worried the committee was how quickly the town could recover.
answers: What worried the committee was how quickly the town could recover.
questions.explanation: what 从句作主语，how quickly 引导的从句作表语，从句内部用陈述语序。
questions.evidence: they asked how quickly the town could recover if the reservoir fell another ten percent

options: If the reservoir fell another ten percent, the town would lose income.
If the reservoir will fall another ten percent, the town would lose income.
If the reservoir fell another ten percent, the town will lost income.
If the reservoir would fall another ten percent, the town lost income.
answers: If the reservoir fell another ten percent, the town would lose income.
questions.explanation: 与现在事实相反的假设：if 从句用过去式，主句用 would + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: they asked how quickly the town could recover if the reservoir fell another ten percent

options: Priya asked Daniel why he thought farms should come first.
Priya asked Daniel why did he think farms should come first.
Priya asked Daniel why he did thought farms should come first.
Priya asked Daniel why thought he farms should come first.
answers: Priya asked Daniel why he thought farms should come first.
questions.explanation: why 引导的间接问句用陈述语序，不用 did。
questions.evidence: He argued that farmers should receive a fixed share first

options: The question is whether every group can accept the plan.
The question is whether can every group accept the plan.
The question is if every group can accept the plan or not?
The question is that whether every group can accept the plan.
answers: The question is whether every group can accept the plan.
questions.explanation: whether 从句作表语，用陈述语序；句末不加问号。
questions.evidence: both eventually accepted it, because it was the only plan that no group could describe as a total loss

options: Grace asked which group could honestly say its need was the smallest.
Grace asked which group could honestly say was its need the smallest.
Grace asked which group honestly could say its need was the smallest?
Grace asked which group could honestly say that its need was smallest?
answers: Grace asked which group could honestly say its need was the smallest.
questions.explanation: which 引导的间接问句用陈述语序，句末用句号。
questions.evidence: She asked a question that silenced the room: "Which of us can honestly say our need is the smallest?"

options: Daniel said that the monthly review was more useful than a single long argument.
Daniel said that was the monthly review more useful than a single long argument.
Daniel said that the monthly review was most useful than a single long argument.
Daniel said the monthly review was more useful that a single long argument.
answers: Daniel said that the monthly review was more useful than a single long argument.
questions.explanation: that 从句作宾语，比较级用 more useful than。
questions.evidence: Daniel later said the monthly review was the most useful decision they made

title: The Reservoir Committee: Who Gets the Water When It Runs Short · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
先看意思：当你想把别人的问题转述出来，而不是直接问，就要用“陈述语序”。比如直接问 "Which of us can say our need is the smallest?"，转述时变成 She asked which of them could say their need was the smallest. 注意三点：一，问句变成从句后，主语在动词前，不再用 do/does/did；二，从句可以用 whether/if 表示“是否”；三，名词性从句（that 从句、what 从句）可以作主语、宾语或表语，例如 What worried them was the speed of recovery. 比较结构（the least popular, more than half）和假设结构（if the reservoir fell, the town would lose income）常与这些从句一起出现。本课新学重点是“间接问句的陈述语序 + whether/if”，复习的是名词性从句作主语和假设条件句。

She asked a question that silenced the room: "Which of us can honestly say our need is the smallest?"
